panels.title: How a key maps to a person

options.content:
### Keys and people are the same picture here

LiteLLM stores a **key** and a **person** as separate things, joined by the key's `user_id`. The spend log only ever holds the **hashed** key, which is why the two look unrelated in the raw tables. Every panel below resolves them:

```
person = spendlog.user
      -> metadata.user_api_key_user_id
      -> VerificationToken.user_id   (the key's owner)
      -> spendlog.end_user
```

`metadata` comes first deliberately: LiteLLM copies the key's alias and owner into each spend row, so attribution **survives the key being deleted** — a plain join loses those rows.

**`(master key)` means attributed to nobody.** `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` is a superuser credential with no owner and no budget, so its usage cannot be billed to a person and no ceiling binds it. Anything in that row is usage you cannot account for — give those callers their own key with `scripts/llm-users.sh --apply`.

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)')) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
select count(*) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
select coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
select round(coalesce(sum(s.spend),0)::numeric,4) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime")

panels.title: Attributed
panels.description: Share of requests that resolve to a real person. Anything short of 100% is usage nobody is accountable for.

targets.rawSql: select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') <> '(unattributed)' and coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') <> 'default_user_id')/nullif(count(*),0),1) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime")

panels.title: Master-key requests
panels.description: Unowned and unbounded. Should be zero in steady state.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as v from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") and coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') = '(master key)'

panels.title: Per person — every surface combined
panels.description: One row per person, API and web UI summed. This is the number to bill, quota or argue about.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') as "Person", count(*) as "Requests", coalesce(sum(s.prompt_tokens),0) as "Prompt", coalesce(sum(s.completion_tokens),0) as "Completion", coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as "Tokens", round(coalesce(sum(s.spend),0)::numeric,4) as "Spend", count(distinct coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)')) as "Keys used", string_agg(distinct case when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') like 'open-webui%' then 'Web UI' when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') = '(master key)' then 'Master key (unattributed)' else 'API / agent' end, ', ') as "Surfaces" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") group by 1 order by 5 desc nulls last

panels.title: Which key belongs to whom
panels.description: The key inventory. LiteLLM shows only a masked key_name -- the full key is shown once at creation and never stored in the clear.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(v.key_alias, '(no alias)') as "Key alias", coalesce(v.user_id, '(unowned)') as "Owner", coalesce(v.key_name, '') as "Key (masked)", round(coalesce(v.spend,0)::numeric,4) as "Spend", coalesce(v.max_budget, 0) as "Budget", v."created_at" as "Created" from "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v order by v.spend desc nulls last

select $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", 1d), coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') as metric, coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as tokens from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Tokens per day, by surface
panels.description: API keys, the web UI's shared key, and anything still riding the master key -- side by side.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", 1d), case when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') like 'open-webui%' then 'Web UI' when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') = '(master key)' then 'Master key (unattributed)' else 'API / agent' end as metric, coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as tokens from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Budget headroom
panels.description: Internal-user ceilings. A person at 100% is refused on BOTH the API and the chat path -- see docs/USAGE-LIMITS.md.

targets.rawSql: select u.user_id as "Person", coalesce(u.user_email,'') as "Email", round(coalesce(u.spend,0)::numeric,4) as "Spend", u.max_budget as "Budget", case when u.max_budget is null or u.max_budget = 0 then null else round((100.0*coalesce(u.spend,0)/u.max_budget)::numeric,1) end as "Used %" from "LiteLLM_UserTable" u where u.user_id not like 'e2e-%' order by 5 desc nulls last

panels.title: Unattributed usage — fix these
panels.description: Requests that resolve to nobody. Almost always the master key in a client config -- replace it with a per-person key.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') as "Key", coalesce(nullif(s."user",''),'(none)') as "user field", coalesce(nullif(s.end_user,''),'(none)') as "end_user", count(*) as "Requests", coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as "Tokens" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") and (coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') = '(unattributed)' or coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') = 'default_user_id') group by 1,2,3 order by 5 desc

panels.title: Recent requests, resolved
panels.description: The raw rows with the person and key resolved. If a total above looks wrong, it is wrong here first.

targets.rawSql: select s."startTime" as "Time", coalesce(nullif(s."user",''), s.metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id', v.user_id, nullif(s.end_user,''), '(unattributed)') as "Person", coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') as "Key", case when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') like 'open-webui%' then 'Web UI' when coalesce(s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias', v.key_alias, '(master key)') = '(master key)' then 'Master key (unattributed)' else 'API / agent' end as "Surface", s.model as "Model", s.prompt_tokens as "Prompt", s.completion_tokens as "Completion", round(coalesce(s.spend,0)::numeric,6) as "Spend" from "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s left join "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v on v.token = s.api_key where $__timeFilter(s."startTime") order by s."startTime" desc limit 200
